entries.claim: Morgan Stanley reported FY2025 (year ended 31 December 2025) net revenues of $70.6 billion, up 14% year over year.
entries.source_ref: Morgan Stanley Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Earnings Results; FY2025 income statement

entries.claim: For Q4 2025 Morgan Stanley reported net revenues of $17.9 billion, net income applicable to Morgan Stanley of $4.4 billion, and diluted EPS of $2.68.
entries.source_ref: Morgan Stanley 4Q25 Earnings Release (quarter ended 31 December 2025)

entries.claim: For FY2025 Morgan Stanley Wealth Management reported net revenue of $31.8 billion, a 29% pre-tax margin, $356 billion of net new assets, and $160 billion of fee-based asset flows.
entries.source_ref: Morgan Stanley 4Q25 Financial Supplement / FY2025 earnings release

entries.claim: As of Q4 2025, Wealth Management client assets were approximately $7.381 trillion; combined Wealth and Investment Management assets were ~$9.3 trillion; Investment Management AUM was $1.895 trillion.
Morgan Stanley Wealth Management has approximately 16,000 financial advisors (FY2025).
entries.source_ref: Morgan Stanley FY2025 disclosures / analyst summaries

entries.claim: Morgan Stanley acquired E*TRADE (announced 20 February 2020; closed 2 October 2020) in an all-stock transaction valued at approximately $13 billion, retaining the E*TRADE brand for self-directed digital brokerage.
entries.source_ref: Morgan Stanley strategic update / acquisition disclosures (2020)

entries.claim: Morgan Stanley closed its acquisition of Eaton Vance on 1 March 2021.
entries.source_ref: Morgan Stanley strategic update / acquisition disclosures (2021)

entries.claim: Morgan Stanley's Q4 2025 net interest income increased year over year, driven by lending growth and balance-sheet mix (cash-sweep and securities-based lending engine).
entries.source_ref: Morgan Stanley 4Q25 Earnings Release (quarter ended 31 December 2025)

entries.claim: Morgan Stanley's Q4 2025 asset management revenue was $5,031 million (vs $4,417 million a year earlier) and transactional revenue was $1,143 million (vs $973 million).
Morgan Stanley uses an 'advisor funnel' to convert client assets into advisor-managed, fee-based relationships, and employs Monte Carlo portfolio-risk/planning tooling in its advisory stack.
entries.source_ref: Morgan Stanley earnings-call coverage and public product materials (2025)

entries.claim: Morgan Stanley's Monte Carlo engine internals, advisory fee grids and cash-sweep rate mechanics are proprietary and not publicly disclosed.
entries.source_ref: pending programme disclosure / ADV brochures / regulatory filings

entries.claim: No Morgan Stanley on-chain contract or digital-asset custody address has been verified against a public block explorer by this squad; Morgan Stanley's blockchain footprint is limited in the public sources reviewed.
entries.source_ref: pending verified-explorer cross-check + issuer disclosure (no address asserted)
